question: What is the value of 512 × 3 - 25 ÷ 15 × 9?
solution:
**Given:**

512 × 3 - 25 ÷ 15 × 9

Concept Used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Solution:**

Simplifying the expression step-by-step:

⇒ 512 × 3 - 25 ÷ 15 × 9

⇒ 1,536 - (25/15) × 9

⇒ 1,536 - (5/3) × 9

⇒ 1,536 - 15

⇒ 1521

**Therefore, the value of the expression is 1,521.**
